name: Logistics & freight vendors
description: Procurement template for carriers and freight forwarders. Adds fleet size and a goods-in-transit insurance certificate on top of the country defaults, and insists the payee name matches the registered entity.

fields.label: Number of vehicles operated
fields.hint: Owned or leased vehicles available for our lanes

documents.label: Goods-in-transit insurance certificate
documents.expects: A current insurance certificate naming the business as the insured party, covering goods in transit
